activity.emptyMessage: Receiving, disposing, declining and refunding this return will each appear here.
activity.errorMessage: Things may well have happened on this return - OpenLinker could not read them just now.
activity.forbiddenMessage: This history includes refund amounts, so it is limited to accounts that handle money. Everything else on this page is unaffected.
activity.forbiddenTitle: Activity is not available to this account
activity.loadingMessage: Reading what has happened on this return.

apiErrors.proposalUnreadable: The credit-note proposal could not be read.
apiErrors.resultUnreadable: The server accepted the change but sent a result this build could not read.
apiErrors.timelineUnreadable: The return activity for this order could not be read.

authorizeReturnDialog.description: You recorded this return yourself. Approving it is an audit stamp confirming it really happened - it does not hold up restock or refund, which already act on the return on their own.
authorizeReturnDialog.genericError: The approval could not be completed. Try again.
authorizeReturnDialog.refusedBody: This return came in from the source, which already decided it. OpenLinker only approves returns recorded here by an operator.
authorizeReturnDialog.title: Give this the OK?

dispose.awaitingAttestation: This line has a stock write waiting on you - see the notice above and mark it handled before restocking more. You can still scrap these units.
dispose.heading: Record what happened to these units
dispose.nothingToDispose: Every received unit on this line has already been dealt with.
dispose.orphanBlocked: This return is not matched to an order, so OpenLinker will not add stock anywhere. You can still scrap these units.

overDisposition.one: You only have {n} received unit left to deal with on this line.
overDisposition.other: You only have {n} received units left to deal with on this line.

dispose.quantityHint: Defaults to everything received but not yet dealt with.
dispose.restockBlockedToast: Recorded - but the stock could not be added.
dispose.restockHelp: Adds the units back to your stock, in the system that owns your stock.
dispose.scrapHelp: Writes the units off. Stock is not changed.

byReason.illegal-transition: This line is already finished, so it cannot change. Reload the page to see where it ended up.
byReason.non-positive-quantity: Record at least one whole unit.
byReason.nothing-advised: The source advised no units on this line, so there is nothing to write off.
byReason.over-disposition: That is more units than this line has received. Reload the page to see the current counts.
byReason.over-receipt: You've recorded more units than the buyer advised. Record what arrived up to the advised quantity, and open a separate return for the rest.
byReason.partially-received: Some units already arrived on this line, so it cannot be written off. Deal with what arrived - the shortfall stays visible against the advised quantity.
byReason.restock-already-blocked: This line already has a stock write waiting on you - mark it handled before restocking more.

error.conflict: This line has changed since the page loaded. Reload and try again.
error.forbidden: Your account cannot record changes to returns.
error.generic: The change could not be recorded. Nothing was saved.
error.notFound: This return line no longer exists. Reload the page.

notReturned.confirmBody: This writes the line off. Use it when you have decided the buyer is not sending the goods back - it is never something OpenLinker concludes on its own.
notReturned.confirmTitle: Record that this parcel is not coming?
notReturned.notePlaceholder: Why is it not coming back?
notReturned.partiallyReceivedHint: Some units already arrived on this line, so it cannot be written off. Deal with what arrived - the shortfall stays visible against the advised quantity.

receive.bulkConfirmBody: This records the full outstanding quantity on every line still awaiting its parcel. Check the parcel against the advised quantities first - each line is recorded as a real arrival.
receive.bulkConfirmTitle: Record every line as fully arrived?
receive.bulkNothing: No line is still awaiting units.
receive.bulkPartial: Some lines could not be recorded. The ones that failed are unchanged.
receive.bulkSuccess: Recorded arrivals on every outstanding line.
receive.heading: Record what arrived
receive.notePlaceholder: Anything worth recording about this arrival
receive.nothingOutstanding: Every advised unit on this line has already arrived.
receive.overReceipt: You've recorded more units than the buyer advised. Record what arrived up to the advised quantity, and open a separate return for the rest.
receive.quantityHint: Defaults to everything still outstanding on this line.
receive.readOnly: Recording what arrived is disabled in the demo.

restockTarget.adapter-unresolved: OpenLinker can't reach the system that owns your stock right now, so it can't say where these units would land.
restockTarget.ambiguous-inventory-master: {n} connections claim to own your stock, so OpenLinker will not guess which one to write to - restocking will be refused until exactly one is set up.
restockTarget.ambiguous-owner: {n} product masters hold stock for this product, so OpenLinker will not guess which one to put the units back into.
restockTarget.no-inventory-master: No connection owns your stock, so restocking cannot add units anywhere. Scrapping still works.
restockTarget.no-position: OpenLinker holds no stock for this product in any connected product master, so it cannot tell where these units would land.
restockTarget.unattributed-owner: The stock for this product has no known owner yet - run a stock sync from the product master, then restock.

decline.blockedAlreadyDeclined: The channel has already reported this return as declined.
decline.blockedNoSourceReturnId: This return has no reference at the channel - there is nothing to ask them about. Returns you recorded yourself are always in this state.
decline.blockedOrphan: This return is not matched to an order, so nothing can be sent to the channel about it yet.
decline.blockedSourceDeclaresNoDecline: This channel publishes no way to decline a return, so OpenLinker has nothing to send.
decline.blockedUnknownReason: OpenLinker could not establish whether this channel accepts a decline, so the action is held back rather than sent into the unknown.
decline.commentDescription: Some channels require a comment for some codes, and shorten it to their own limit.
decline.commentTooLong: Keep the comment to 500 characters or fewer.
decline.confirmBody: Declining tells the channel you are refusing this return. The channel decides what happens next - OpenLinker records the outcome it reports.
decline.readOnly: You do not have permission to make changes.
decline.reasonCodeDescription: The channel’s own code for refusing a return. OpenLinker passes it through unchanged; if the channel does not accept it, the reply below lists the codes it does.

already-declined.body: This return was already declined, so nothing was sent again.
already-declined.title: Already declined

decline-sent.body: The channel has the request and has not yet reported the outcome. OpenLinker records their decision when it arrives - until then this return is not declined.
decline-sent.title: Decline sent

declined.body: The channel reported the decline as a fact, with the time it happened.
declined.title: The channel declined this return

in-flight.body: An earlier request for this return is still open, so no second request was sent.
in-flight.title: A decline is already in progress

refused.body: OpenLinker asked and the channel said no. Its own words:
refused.title: The channel refused the request

unknown.body: The request was sent. Re-open this return in a moment to see what the channel recorded.
unknown.title: The channel answered in a way OpenLinker does not recognise

header.noChannelReference: None - this return has no reference at the channel

lines.empty: The channel reported no lines for this return.
lines.notTrackedYetHint: OpenLinker does not yet follow the goods or the refund for a return. It records what the channel reports, and this will start moving in a later release.
lines.tableCaption: Returned lines, in the order the channel reported them
lines.unmatchedLine: Could not be matched to a line
lines.unmatchedLineHint: OpenLinker could not tell which line of the order this returned item belongs to. The return is still recorded in full.

unreadableLines.one: 1 line of this return could not be read and is not shown.
unreadableLines.other: {n} lines of this return could not be read and are not shown.

orphanBanner.matchActionReadOnly: You do not have permission to make changes.
orphanBanner.reattribution: If the order is ingested later, OpenLinker matches this return to it automatically and the actions below become available.
orphanBanner.safeHere: It is safe here - nothing is lost.
orphanBanner.title: This return is not matched to an order.

page.loadingMessage: Fetching this return and its lines.
page.notFoundMessage: This return does not exist, or it has been removed.
page.unreadableMessage: OpenLinker received this return but could not read it. This is a version mismatch, not a problem with the return itself.

rail.inDoubtNote: OpenLinker asked for this refund but could not confirm what happened. Do not refund again - check with the source first.
rail.independenceNote: These two move independently. A marketplace can refund the buyer before the parcel arrives, and a parcel can arrive with no refund owed.

sourcePanel.explainer: These values are the channel’s own, recorded word for word. OpenLinker does not translate or interpret them.

noMatches.message: Try widening or clearing the filters to see the returns recorded so far.
noMatches.title: No returns match these filters

none.message: Returns reported by your connected channels will appear here.
none.title: No returns recorded yet

notConfigured.message: None of your connected channels report returns to OpenLinker yet. This is a configuration state, not a failure - nothing is wrong with the returns you already have.
notConfigured.title: Returns ingestion is not set up

pastEnd.message: This page is past the end of the results.
pastEnd.title: Nothing on this page

error.title: Unable to load returns
error.unreadableEnvelopeMessage: The response came back in a shape this version of OpenLinker could not read, so no returns are shown. This does not mean there are none recorded.

orphan.explanation: Returns for orders OpenLinker has never seen. They are kept, but nothing is triggered from them - no stock change, no refund, no credit note - until they are matched to an order.

page.description: Returns reported by your connected channels, newest first. OpenLinker records what the channel says and does not reinterpret it.
page.recordActionReadOnly: You do not have permission to record returns.
page.title: Returns

segment.stripLabel: Filter returns by what needs doing

sourceStatus.attribution: Reported by the source channel, word for word. OpenLinker does not interpret this value.
sourceStatus.notReportedHint: The source channel reported no status for this return.

unreadableRows.one: {n} return on this page could not be read and is not shown.
unreadableRows.other: {n} returns on this page could not be read and are not shown.

matchReturnDialog.alreadyAttributedBody: Someone else - another operator, or OpenLinker's own background check - matched this return to an order already. There is nothing left to do here.

matchReturnDialog.fieldDescription: Must be an order OpenLinker already has on file.

matchReturnDialog.title: Which order is this?

panel.executedOutOfBand: You recorded this. OpenLinker did not move the money.
panel.none: No refund has been recorded against this return yet.
panel.orphanBlocked: This return is not matched to an order, so a refund cannot be recorded against it yet.
panel.recordNotWritten: The refund was recorded against this return, but the linked order refund record could not be written. The money state is saved - do not confirm again.

refundCeiling.acknowledgeHint: Tick this to record the refund deliberately, then confirm again.
refundCeiling.title: This refund is more than the order's total

byReason.already-attempted: A refund has already been recorded or triggered for every line on this return. Refunding again would pay the buyer twice.
byReason.no-lines: This return has no lines to refund against.
byReason.outstanding-in-doubt: A previous refund attempt crossed into the source and OpenLinker never learned what happened. Confirm what the source actually did before attempting another - do not retry blindly.

refundError.conflict: This return has changed since the page loaded. Reload and try again.
refundError.generic: The refund could not be recorded. Nothing was saved.
refundError.notFound: This return no longer exists. Reload the page.

orderReturnsPanel.emptyMessage: Returns reported against this order will appear here.

orderReturnsPanel.loadingMessage: Reading the returns recorded against this order.
orderReturnsPanel.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} returns on this order.

orphanWorklist.approveReadOnly: You do not have permission to approve returns.
orphanWorklist.errorMessage: OpenLinker could not read this list just now. This is not a statement about it.
orphanWorklist.needsApprovalDescription: You recorded these yourself. Approving is an audit stamp confirming it really happened - it does not hold up restock or refund.
orphanWorklist.needsApprovalEmpty: Nothing is waiting for your approval.

orphanWorklist.needsOrderEmpty: Nothing is waiting to be matched to an order.
orphanWorklist.needsOrderTruncated: Showing {shown} of {total} - more are waiting to be matched.
orphanWorklist.unreadableMessage: The response did not match what this version of OpenLinker expects, so nothing is shown here. This is not evidence there is nothing.

proposal.ambiguousBanner: OpenLinker could not tell which invoice line some of these returned items came from. Pick one for each before confirming - it decides which line the credit note corrects.
proposal.candidatesDiffer: These candidates differ in price or tax rate, so the choice changes the amount credited.
proposal.cleanBanner: Every returned line matched exactly one invoice line.
proposal.handoffConnectionStale: The connection that issued this invoice is disabled or no longer set up for invoicing - a correction cannot be issued from here right now.
proposal.handoffUnavailable: No correction flow is available for this invoice from here yet.
proposal.headlineEstimateNote: Estimated from the invoice's own line prices - the issued document's amounts come from your invoicing provider.
proposal.irreversible: Once a credit note has been issued and sent, it cannot be withdrawn. Check every line before you confirm.
proposal.noAutoIssue: OpenLinker never issues a credit note on its own. It matches the returned lines to the invoice and shows you what it found; issuing is always your decision.

noMatchReasons.ambiguous-invoice-line: This return could not be matched to exactly one invoice line automatically. Check the invoice by hand before crediting it.
noMatchReasons.disposition-not-confirmed: These units are not confirmed disposed of yet - a refused restock is still outstanding.
noMatchReasons.no-line-by-name: No invoice line has this name.
noMatchReasons.no-line-name: The returned line has no name to match on.
noMatchReasons.quantity-exceeds-invoiced: More units were returned than the invoice billed.

proposal.orphanAbsent: No credit note is prepared for an unmatched return. Match it to an order first.

outcomes.no-disposed-lines: No returned units have been disposed of yet.
outcomes.no-invoice: No invoice has been issued for this order, so there is nothing to correct.
outcomes.no-line-snapshot: The invoice was issued before OpenLinker recorded its lines, so they cannot be matched automatically.
outcomes.nothing-correctable: Nothing on this return can be credited yet.

proposal.readOnly: Your account can see this credit note but cannot record it.
proposal.recordBlockedAmbiguous: At least one line needs a pick before this can be recorded.

restockAttested.byOther: Stock added manually by another operator on {date}.
restockAttested.byYou: Stock added manually by you on {date}.
restockAttested.disclaimer: OpenLinker did not change your stock.
restockAttested.toast: Recorded that you handled the stock yourself.

restockBlocked.body: OpenLinker recorded the disposition, but {connection} does not accept stock adjustments from OpenLinker, so your stock has not changed.
restockBlocked.bodyUnknownConnection: OpenLinker recorded the disposition, but the system that owns your stock does not accept stock adjustments from OpenLinker, so your stock has not changed.
restockBlocked.openUnknownConnection: Open the system that owns your stock
restockBlocked.remedy: Add {quantity} × {sku} in {connection} yourself, then mark this handled.
restockBlocked.remedyUnknownConnection: Add {quantity} × {sku} in the system that owns your stock yourself, then mark this handled.
restockBlocked.remedyUnknownSku: Add {quantity} × the returned units in {connection} yourself, then mark this handled.
restockBlocked.remedyUnknownSkuAndConnection: Add {quantity} × the returned units in the system that owns your stock yourself, then mark this handled.
restockBlocked.title: Stock was not added.

restockBlockedExplainer.body: Adding stock back needs a write into the system that owns your stock. {connection} accepts stock readings from OpenLinker but not stock adjustments, so OpenLinker recorded what you decided and stopped there rather than telling you it had done something it hadn’t.
restockBlockedExplainer.bodyUnknownConnection: Adding stock back needs a write into the system that owns your stock. The system that owns your stock accepts stock readings from OpenLinker but not stock adjustments, so OpenLinker recorded what you decided and stopped there rather than telling you it had done something it hadn’t.
restockBlockedExplainer.heading: OpenLinker can publish your stock, but it can't always change it.
restockBlockedExplainer.reassurance: Nothing is lost: the units are still counted as received on this return, and this message stays until you say you’ve handled it.

timeline.refundExecuted: Executed by OpenLinker against the source.
timeline.refundRecordedOnly: Recorded by an operator - OpenLinker did not move the money and does not claim to have.
timeline.restockBlocked: The stock write was refused - the units are not back in the book yet.
